Hardwick Electric Department, Board of Commissioners page (live): Michael Ambrosino (Chair, term to 2027), Renaud Demers (2027), Jake Lester (2027) -- already recorded -- and Myles Kamisher-Koch (Vice Chair, term to June 30, 2029).
